description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android app. The fragment displays AI-driven sharing suggestions, an AI assistant banner with quick action chips, and manages a RecyclerView populated with suggestions retrieved from SuggestionEngine. It includes lifecycle methods like onCreateView and onViewCreated, and contains an inner class SuggestionAdapter to handle suggestion item views.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays AI sharing suggestions and an AI assistant banner with quick actions.

classes.name: SuggestionAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView Adapter for displaying a list of suggestion strings.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components, simulates AI loading, populates suggestion list, and sets up quick action chips.

methods.name: addActionChip
methods.description: Creates and adds a clickable Chip widget to a ChipGroup.

methods.name: SuggestionAdapter
methods.description: Inner class implementing RecyclerView.Adapter to display suggestion items.
